# Reference: Standard-to-check coverage

**Generated by `scripts/gen-standard-coverage.mjs`. Do not edit this page.** A drift guard in `npm test` fails when this file, `STANDARD.md` and the check registry disagree, which is what stops the mapping going stale (ADR 0059, every MUST maps to a check, a SHOULD or a stated gap).

Standard version **0.17**. **139** `MUST` / `MUST NOT` tokens in `STANDARD.md`, of which **123** become the **103** clause rows below and **16** are excluded for a stated reason. The two numbers reconcile exactly, on every run: a clause the parser loses would otherwise be a `MUST` this page silently declares covered, which is the failure ADR 0059 names as the risk of its own fix.

## What a disposition means

| Disposition | Count | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | 29 | A named spine check enforces the clause. |
| `partial` | 14 | A named spine check enforces PART of it. The note says what is not checked. |
| `house` | 10 | Enforced outside the graded spine, by a named guard in this repository. A third-party plugin gets no such check. |
| `ruled` | 7 | [ADR 0059 (every MUST maps to a check, a SHOULD or a stated gap)](../internal/decisions/0059-every-must-maps-to-a-check-a-should-or-a-stated-gap.md) ruled its disposition. The ruling is quoted in the note and is **not yet applied**, so the clause still reads `MUST`. |
| `gap` | 23 | No check enforces it and no ADR has ruled it. **A gap is not a defect list.** It is the list of clauses that need a ruling. |
| `grader-facing` | 14 | The clause's own subject is the tooling, not a graded plugin, so no `reqId` can enforce it. Classified from the clause's grammar, not by judgement. |
| `list-stem` | 4 | Introduces the bullets that carry the requirement; each bullet has its own row. |
| `table-header` | 2 | A table header or schema cell, not a requirement clause. |

## Agreement with ADR 0059

ADR 0059 ruled seven clauses. Each is carried by a row below, and generation FAILS if any is not, so this page cannot quietly drift away from the decision it implements. **One of the seven has been applied to `STANDARD.md`:** the sec 7.3 `HISTORY.md` demotion, at Standard 0.17. Its row reads `gap`, because the MUST left on that line is the `metadata.version` half, which nothing checks and no ADR has ruled. The other six still read `MUST` in the Standard, which is why each appears as `ruled` rather than as `checked` or as a `SHOULD`.

| ADR 0059 clause | Carried by |
| --- | --- |
| sec 7.3 `HISTORY.md` at Silver+ | sec 7.3 line 319 |
| sec 5.1 entry `path` and `version` agree with disk | sec 5.1 line 291 |
| sec 3.10 `AGENTS.md` links resolve | sec 3.10 line 229 |
| sec 3.10 `AGENTS.md` counts agree | sec 3.10 line 229 |
| sec 7.2 a drifted sample is an error | sec 7.2 line 316 |
| sec 7.4 version propagation is verifiable | sec 7.4 line 324; sec 7.4 line 329 |
| sec 8.2 name collisions | sec 8.2 line 378 |
